Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

That sounds like a great plan! Since you’ve completed the theory and pool sessions, the *2-day Open Water Referral Course* is the right option, provided you bring referral paperwork signed by a PADI instructor. The refresher is booked as a *Dive Mini Course*.

A refresher and a certified diver can go together on the same outing.
